appliedScenePlan.nextHook: the Kaufhaus continues to reconfigure around consumption, conflict unresolved but transformed
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close frame on the Kaufhaus floor: the weathered practical sculpture (pitted surface, visible joins and rigging, filmed physically) is already in frame, its articulated arms holding and aligning soot‑marked products into neat stacks. Shoppers' hands reach in to take items and drop coins into a small tin; low, warm practical lighting catches soot and coin glints. Architecture cues (mezzanine edge, glass balustrade) keep the location identifiable. No readable text or logos.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Start with the sculpture and stacks visible. Animate only the visible motions: the sculpture's rigged arms (practical puppet mechanics) shifting a product into a stack, shoppers' hands reaching and coins clinking into the tin, and a subtle camera push to close on the tin. Do not animate the sculpture appearing.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: tight two-shot on sculpture hands and tin of coins, slow push to the clinking coins
